Description: Audio Object Editing: creates and composes AudioObjects (a Basic Audio Object plus its editing properties). One object is open at a time. OPENING IS DONE BY PORT, not by Command: an object arrives on BasicAudioObject or on AudioObject, and which Data Type delivered it tells this AIM whether it is editing a Basic Audio Object or a composed one. Since ManagedObject is an ObjectOrID, an open may carry only the identifier and the content is fetched from Shared Storage. Creation opens implicitly. ACTING IS DONE BY COMMAND: each user action is one User Command on the UserCommand Port, acting on whatever is open, so an interactive session is a sequence of runs rather than one long one.
